title: Phase Greenhouse Ruins
text: Two hemispherical crystal rooms in the Phase Crystal Grove are joined by a configuration corridor. Their walls and domes are Phase Crystal Blocks. The panel opposite the main entrance holds the building's phase; right-click to switch connected crystals between solid and inverted states.
The cultivation greenhouse contains two Alchemical Catalysis Chambers and one liquid treasure orb. The storeroom holds two item treasure orbs.
